evidence.excerpt: We construct BenchShield Trajectories, a human-labeled corpus of 456 adjudicated trajectories from more than 31,000 public agent runs across three benchmarks.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: This interactivity makes evaluations vulnerable to reward hacking: an agent improves its measured score by exploiting the reward-relevant trajectory instead of solving the intended task.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Its runtime analysis achieves 96% accuracy in detecting reward hacking from infrastructure-side evidence.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Compared with an agentic hackability scanner baseline on the same tasks and model, BenchShield improves full-chain recall from 23-94% to 77-100%, same-vector coverage from 16-56% to 43-78%, and reduces per-task cost by up to 65%.
